Listen to each complete recording first. Then listen to one short part at a time and tell us what you hear.

The short cuts are rough automatic suggestions. If a cut misses or clips the displayed unit, select “Bad audio cut / boundary”. You do not need to fix it or judge its tone. Human recordings can also receive “No” or “Unsure”.

Confidence means how sure you are about what you heard and your judgment—not why it sounds that way. High: sure · Medium: some ambiguity · Low: unsure.
